why_this_order: a short rig run for three things that had no row (the owner, 2026-11-24): a new release in the kit, a Linux sign-in name that is not the Windows one, and a file copy of only some, then the rest
why_linux_name: the Windows account is 'rig'. The rig's job is a stand-in, so this holds what the installer and settle-in do with a chosen name, not the job writer's own --linux-name

stages.why: the rig's stick, made by the rig's own builder (a stand-in for the stick writer)
known files in Windows before the job is written
install beside Windows under the chosen sign-in name; the test then reaches Linux as that name
the picker's choice, as the window hands it to settle-in: one folder and one file, none of the rest
Bring more files: the rest comes, and a run after that finds nothing to do
leave the rig starting Windows first
